description: Stardew Valley mod adding new event commands, mainly involving flow control.

releases.name: 0.13.1-beta
releases.body:
- Changed stream behavior to keep processing unfinished actor movements even after the stream ends.
- Renamed the condition-level `Script` to `ScriptOnSatisfy` in the player control data model.
- Added support for the `${count}` token to tile/actor scripts in player control data.

releases.name: 0.13.0-beta
releases.body:
- Added `PlayerControl` (major feature) and associated data asset.
- Added a console command `ecc_sample` to play sample events straight from the mod folder.
  - Added a sample event to show off PlayerControl.
- Added `ActorSnapToGrid` and `ActorFaceToward`.
- Added an offset argument to `CGShow` so you aren't locked to the screen center.
- Improved color parsing in `CGShow` to support decimal rgb(a).
- Added window resize handling to the CG code.
- Fixed temporary map tiles and map overrides not cleaning up when used in streams.
- Fixed some commands (the ones which call Event.Update directly) causing subtle breakage (as a result) when used in streams.

releases.name: 0.12.0-beta
releases.body:
- Added repeat blocks (`RepeatCount`/`RepeatTime`/`RepeatEnd`).
- Added `StreamSuspend`/`StreamResume` (and aliases `StreamSleep`/`StreamWake`).
- Added CG-displaying commands (`CGShow`/`CGHide`).
- Added simultaneous commands (`Merge`/`MergeEnd`), which actually work the way `beginSimultaneousCommand`/`endSimultaneousCommand` sound like they should (they use streams).
- Added stream-safe versions of `message` and `speak`.
- Added a stream example script and video preview to author guide.
- **Breaking Changes**:
  - Reserved the `ECC` prefix in stream ids for internal use, just like it is reserved in variables.

releases.name: 0.11.0-beta
releases.body:
- Fixed viewport handler function to fully pause when game is not focused.
- Added `ViewportShake`. It has its own queue, so the other viewport commands gained new optional arguments.
- Added `AmbientLightReset`.
- Adjusted AmbientLight behavior (mainly around use of Color.White) to better match what I think users will expect.
- Added modulus operator (`%`) support to the event variable parser.
- **Breaking Changes**:
  - `ActorPathTo` -> `ActorPathfind`
  - Coordinate parsing for ViewportMove and ActorPathfind has changed to be more consistent (and hopefully more clear). Check the author guide!

releases.name: 0.10.0-beta
releases.body:
- Added automatic replacement of some problematic event commands when used in streams:
    - `emote`
    - `faceDirection`
    - `message` (causes an error)
    - `pause`
    - `speak` (causes an error)
- Added a token resolver (for tokenized strings) that runs the var parser, so you can use it in `speak`
- **Breaking changes**:
    - `ichortower.ECC_StreamPause` -> `ichortower.ECC_Pause`
